reading.body:
DartPoints Asheville publishes 1.5 MW of IT capacity, making it the fifth-largest disclosed facility in North Carolina and accounting for 3 percent of the state's 50.3 MW of published data center power.

The facility occupies 11,200 square feet at Biltmore Park Technology Center with N+1 backup power covering 2,050 kW of generator and 975 kW of UPS capacity. At typical AI training density, 1.5 MW supports approximately 37 racks or 300 accelerators. Seven network providers across five fiber entries provide connectivity options.

North Carolina has 19 mapped facilities, but only five publish capacity figures. DartPoints Asheville is substantially smaller than the state's leading facilities and represents a sparse set of locations with disclosed specifications. The operator's own site does not indicate which workloads currently run here or name specific tenants.

This facility's backup power budget suggests readiness for continuous operation, a requirement for any infrastructure hosting production AI workloads. Whether that capacity is currently in use remains unpublished.
